title: The Ghost Shopper
caption: Your housemate went shopping, and the whole house can see it straight away. 👻 Share one fridge list at fridgeroo.netlify.app 🏠
igSound: Season of the Witch – Lana Del Rey
ytTitle: The Ghost Shopper: Your Housemate Restocked the Fridge 👻
why: Shared-home feature shown as a housemate adding food everyone can see (not a blame joke like Who Ate My Cheese?). Spookyhouse/charcoal, hook-card-punch-end differs from disco/berry and trap/grape neighbours.
